alerts.title: État du porte‑montre incohérent
alerts.description: Le porte‑montre est brisé puis apparaît intact sans réparation ni remplacement.

evidence.quote: Runa drops her brass pocket watch. Its glass breaks and its mechanism stops.
Runa checks the same brass pocket watch: its glass is intact and the mechanism works.

alerts.title: Cahier rouge intact après combustion
alerts.description: Le cahier est réduit en cendres puis réapparaît complet sans explication.

evidence.quote: Lasse burns his red notebook completely. Only ashes remain.
Lasse opens the same red notebook, intact with all its original pages.

alerts.title: Flacon jaune plein sans remplissage indiqué
alerts.description: Le flacon est vidé puis plein sans mention de remplissage.

evidence.quote: Ibsy empties her yellow flask completely and screws its cap back on.
Ibsy pours water from her same yellow flask, now completely full. It has not been refilled.

alerts.title: Carte perdue puis réapparition inexpliquée
alerts.description: La carte est perdue dans la rivière puis retrouvée sans récupération ni remplacement.

evidence.quote: A gust carries Lasse's folded street map into the river. It sinks out of reach and is lost.
Lasse unfolds his same folded street map. He has neither recovered it nor obtained a replacement.

alerts.title: Thermos inexplicably refilled
alerts.description: Le thermos est vide dans S007 et apparaît plein dans S011 sans aucune indication de remplissage ou de remplacement.

evidence.quote: Runa pours out every last drop from her black coffee thermos. It is completely empty.
Runa pours coffee from her same black coffee thermos, now completely full. Nobody has refilled it since breakfast.

alerts.title: Lunettes réparées sans explication
alerts.description: Les lunettes sont cassées dans S007 alors qu'elles sont intactes dans S011 sans mention de réparation ou de remplacement.

evidence.quote: Lasse snaps both arms off his green reading glasses and cracks both lenses.
Lasse wears his same green reading glasses, with intact arms and lenses. They have not been repaired or replaced since breakfast.

alerts.title: Portefeuille de passeport réapparaît intact
alerts.description: Le porte‑passeport est détruit en morceaux dans S007 mais réapparaît complet et intact dans S011 sans justification.

evidence.quote: Runa cuts her navy passport holder into tiny pieces and burns the pieces to ash.
Runa opens her same navy passport holder, completely intact. No replacement has been obtained since breakfast.
